description:
Team Oopy-timism, took on the challenge Abandoned but not forgotten. We turned actual NASA data into interactive experiences, through games, stories, lessons and quick decision making to keep the children on their toes.

From the silence of the Moon to the mayhem of Mars, we created a space for every kind of explorer, with thoughtfully designed experiences for learners across K-12.

Channeling curiosity and their wonder towards space and exploration to make learning fun and unforgettable.
